definitions.explanation: The spreading of disease from one person or organism to another.
The figurative spreading of feelings or behaviors from one person to others.

examples.japanese: {伝染|でんせん}{病|びょう}に{気|き}をつける。
examples.english: I am careful about infectious diseases.

examples.japanese: あくびが{伝染|でんせん}した。
{笑|わら}いは{伝染|でんせん}する。
この{病気|びょうき}は{人|ひと}から{人|ひと}へ{伝染|でんせん}する。
examples.english: This disease is transmitted from person to person.

examples.japanese: {伝染|でんせん}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{手|て}を{洗|あら}うことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Washing your hands is important to prevent the spread of infection.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{不安|ふあん}が{周|まわ}りに{伝染|でんせん}した。
examples.english: Her anxiety spread to those around her.

notes:
{伝染|でんせん} describes the spread of disease or behaviors.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {伝染|でんせん}する: to be transmitted, to spread
- {伝染|でんせん}{病|びょう}: infectious disease
- {伝染|でんせん}{力|りょく}: infectivity
- {空気|くうき}{伝染|でんせん}: airborne transmission

RELATED WORDS:
- {感染|かんせん}: infection
- {蔓延|まんえん}: spread, rampancy
- {流行|りゅうこう}: epidemic, trend

[Register: Neutral]
